name: Jackplot
storyline:
You wake up in a strange basement. In front of you stands an old slot machine, a worn-out mattress, and a mysterious man offering items to improve your odds... for a price.

Jackplot challenges you to overcome a debt imposed by the machine while exploring the fine line between luck and strategy. Every spin could bring you closer to freedom—or drag you deeper into despair. How far will you go to keep playing?
summary:
Jackplot was born during an internal game jam at Typing Monke. The idea was simple but captivating, and after validating the concept, we decided to expand it into a full-fledged project.

However, just a week into development, a game eerily similar to ours surfaced. Instead of competing with an existing title, we chose to pivot to a fresh idea. But rather than let the work we’d done go to waste, we’re sharing Jackplot here on Itch.io as a snapshot of our creative journey.
